summary: The Georgia lookout list places a luthersville tower in Meriwether County; no other source found describes it. No source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: List entry luthersville: coordinates, Meriwether County, and 935 in the elevation column
The list says names for towers numbered 73 and above are the compiler's own
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: The same list has a separate Meriwether Lookout Tower entry at 33.03013, -84.75687
Luthersville is located in northern Meriwether County
evidence.quote: Luthersville is located in northern Meriwether County

notes_for_editor: The Georgia list is the only source that names a luthersville tower. Its name is the list's own label, since the entry is numbered 254 (the list says names for 73 and above are the compiler's own). Eastern U.S. Lookouts has no Luthersville page (404), and the NHLR and FFLOS Georgia index pages in the cache list no Luthersville entry. Wikipedia is used only for the town's location, as a lead rather than a primary source. The story is about 105 words, under the 120-word floor, because no further evidence exists. The Meriwether Lookout Tower (us-ga-meriwether) is a different entry about 20 km to the south; keep the two apart. Leave the record unverified until a Georgia Forestry Commission or Meriwether County source turns up.
